existing.id: Daftarkan ulang konektor Hermes yang sudah aktif pada profil ini; login dan keberhasilan operasi tetap perlu diperiksa terpisah.
existing.en: Reuse connectors already enabled in this Hermes profile; authentication and successful operations still need separate verification.

artcraft.id: Daftarkan kelompok 15 aplikasi kreatif ArtCraft untuk video, gambar, audio, desain, dokumen, dan 3D; aplikasi/runtime dipasang terpisah.
artcraft.en: Register the group of 15 ArtCraft creative apps for video, images, audio, design, documents, and 3D; apps/runtimes are installed separately.

gdrive-web.id: Akses file Google Drive melalui web ketika tugas memerlukannya; perlu login dan izin akun, mengikuti kebijakan browser aktif.
gdrive-web.en: Access Google Drive files through the web for a requested task; requires account sign-in and permission under the active browser policy.

perplexity.id: Riset dan pencarian melalui Perplexity; akses web/aplikasi serta batas akun diperiksa saat dipakai, tanpa membuka aplikasi sekarang.
perplexity.en: Research and search with Perplexity; web/app access and account limits are checked when used, without opening the app now.

youtube-chrome.id: Akses YouTube untuk riset video melalui rute yang tersedia; browser personal memerlukan izin sesuai tugas dan kebijakan aktif.
youtube-chrome.en: Access YouTube for video research through the available route; personal-browser access requires task-scoped permission and the active policy.

tiktok.id: Riset konten TikTok melalui web/aplikasi; login, izin akun, dan kebijakan browser tetap berlaku.
tiktok.en: Research TikTok content through the web/app; sign-in, account permissions, and browser policy still apply.

antigravity.id: Gunakan IDE Antigravity untuk workspace coding yang dipilih; IDE harus terpasang dan baru dibuka saat ada tugas.
antigravity.en: Use Antigravity IDE for the selected coding workspace; the IDE must be installed and opens only for a task.

blender.id: Pengerjaan scene, model, animasi, dan render 3D di Blender melalui rute yang terdaftar; perlu Blender dan adapter yang sesuai.
blender.en: Work on Blender scenes, models, animation, and 3D renders through the registered route; requires Blender and a compatible adapter.

blender-cli.id: Kendalikan Blender lewat harness CLI-Anything untuk tugas 3D/render; perlu Blender dan executable cli-anything-blender.
blender-cli.en: Control Blender through the CLI-Anything harness for 3D/render tasks; requires Blender and cli-anything-blender.

ffmpeg.id: Konversi, potong, gabungkan, atau periksa media audio/video lewat CLI lokal; perlu executable FFmpeg.
ffmpeg.en: Convert, trim, combine, or inspect local audio/video through the CLI; requires the FFmpeg executable.

cli-hub.id: Cari dan kelola harness CLI-Anything; menampilkan katalog tidak memasang atau menjalankan harness/aplikasi lain.
cli-hub.en: Find and manage CLI-Anything harnesses; viewing the catalog does not install or run other harnesses/apps.

libreoffice.id: Olah dokumen, spreadsheet, dan presentasi lewat harness LibreOffice; perlu aplikasi dan harness CLI-Anything.
libreoffice.en: Work with documents, spreadsheets, and presentations through the LibreOffice harness; requires the app and CLI-Anything harness.

gimp.id: Edit gambar raster dan komposisi melalui harness GIMP; perlu GIMP dan harness CLI-Anything.
gimp.en: Edit raster images and compositions through the GIMP harness; requires GIMP and its CLI-Anything harness.

obs.id: Atur scene dan rekaman/streaming OBS melalui harness; mulai merekam atau siaran tetap merupakan tindakan tugas terpisah.
obs.en: Manage OBS scenes and recording/streaming through its harness; starting recording or broadcasting remains a separate task action.

audacity.id: Edit dan olah audio lewat harness Audacity; perlu Audacity dan harness CLI-Anything.
audacity.en: Edit and process audio through the Audacity harness; requires Audacity and its CLI-Anything harness.

inkscape.id: Buat dan edit grafis vektor/SVG melalui harness Inkscape; perlu Inkscape dan harness CLI-Anything.
inkscape.en: Create and edit vector/SVG graphics through the Inkscape harness; requires Inkscape and its CLI-Anything harness.

krita.id: Ilustrasi dan lukisan digital melalui harness Krita; perlu Krita dan harness CLI-Anything.
krita.en: Create illustrations and digital paintings through the Krita harness; requires Krita and its CLI-Anything harness.

kdenlive.id: Susun dan edit timeline video melalui harness Kdenlive; perlu Kdenlive dan harness CLI-Anything.
kdenlive.en: Assemble and edit video timelines through the Kdenlive harness; requires Kdenlive and its CLI-Anything harness.

drawio.id: Buat dan edit diagram alur atau arsitektur melalui harness draw.io; perlu aplikasi dan harness yang sesuai.
drawio.en: Create and edit flowcharts or architecture diagrams through the draw.io harness; requires the app and compatible harness.

filmcraft.id: Pengerjaan video dan timeline editing di FilmCraft; perlu aplikasi serta adapter CLI yang tersedia.
filmcraft.en: Work on video and editing timelines in FilmCraft; requires the app and an available CLI adapter.

effectcraft.id: Pengerjaan efek visual dan motion di EffectCraft; perlu aplikasi serta adapter CLI yang tersedia.
effectcraft.en: Work on visual effects and motion in EffectCraft; requires the app and an available CLI adapter.

photocraft.id: Pengerjaan dan penyuntingan foto di PhotoCraft; perlu aplikasi serta adapter CLI yang tersedia.
photocraft.en: Work on and edit photos in PhotoCraft; requires the app and an available CLI adapter.

lightcraft.id: Kelola dan kembangkan foto, warna, serta hasil ekspor di LightCraft; perlu aplikasi/adapter dan library foto yang dapat dipakai.
lightcraft.en: Manage and develop photos, color, and exports in LightCraft; requires the app/adapter and an available photo library.

soundcraft.id: Pengerjaan audio, penyuntingan, dan mixing di SoundCraft; perlu aplikasi serta adapter CLI yang tersedia.
soundcraft.en: Work on audio editing and mixing in SoundCraft; requires the app and an available CLI adapter.

designcraft.id: Pengerjaan desain visual dan layout di DesignCraft; perlu aplikasi serta adapter CLI yang tersedia.
designcraft.en: Work on visual design and layouts in DesignCraft; requires the app and an available CLI adapter.

vectorcraft.id: Pengerjaan ilustrasi dan grafis vektor di VectorCraft; perlu aplikasi serta adapter CLI yang tersedia.
vectorcraft.en: Work on vector illustrations and graphics in VectorCraft; requires the app and an available CLI adapter.

figcraft.id: Pengerjaan desain antarmuka dan layout di FigCraft; perlu aplikasi serta adapter CLI yang tersedia.
figcraft.en: Work on interface designs and layouts in FigCraft; requires the app and an available CLI adapter.

wordcraft.id: Pengerjaan dokumen teks dan pemformatan di WordCraft; perlu aplikasi serta adapter CLI yang tersedia.
wordcraft.en: Work on text documents and formatting in WordCraft; requires the app and an available CLI adapter.

gridcraft.id: Pengerjaan tabel dan spreadsheet di GridCraft; perlu aplikasi serta adapter CLI yang tersedia.
gridcraft.en: Work on tables and spreadsheets in GridCraft; requires the app and an available CLI adapter.

deckcraft.id: Pengerjaan slide dan presentasi di DeckCraft; perlu aplikasi serta adapter CLI yang tersedia.
deckcraft.en: Work on slides and presentations in DeckCraft; requires the app and an available CLI adapter.

pdfcraft.id: Pengerjaan dokumen PDF di PDFCraft; perlu aplikasi serta adapter CLI yang tersedia.
pdfcraft.en: Work on PDF documents in PDFCraft; requires the app and an available CLI adapter.

cadcraft.id: Pengerjaan gambar dan rancangan CAD di CADCraft; perlu aplikasi serta adapter CLI yang tersedia.
cadcraft.en: Work on CAD drawings and designs in CADCraft; requires the app and an available CLI adapter.

solidcraft.id: Pengerjaan model solid dan rancangan 3D di SolidCraft; perlu aplikasi serta adapter CLI yang tersedia.
solidcraft.en: Work on solid models and 3D designs in SolidCraft; requires the app and an available CLI adapter.

craftanything.id: Pengerjaan proyek kreatif melalui Craft Anything; fungsi yang dapat dipanggil bergantung aplikasi/adapter terpasang.
craftanything.en: Work on creative projects through Craft Anything; callable functions depend on the installed app/adapter.

materialcraft.id: Pengerjaan material untuk proyek visual/3D di MaterialCraft; perlu aplikasi serta adapter CLI yang tersedia.
materialcraft.en: Work on materials for visual/3D projects in MaterialCraft; requires the app and an available CLI adapter.

texturecraft.id: Pengerjaan tekstur untuk proyek visual/3D di TextureCraft; perlu aplikasi serta adapter CLI yang tersedia.
texturecraft.en: Work on textures for visual/3D projects in TextureCraft; requires the app and an available CLI adapter.

git.id: Kelola versi source code dan riwayat perubahan lewat Git; push atau penulisan remote tetap memerlukan izin tugas dan akses akun.
git.en: Manage source versions and change history with Git; pushing or writing to a remote still requires task permission and account access.

gitlab.id: Akses proyek dan data GitLab melalui adapter yang terdaftar; perlu autentikasi serta izin proyek yang sesuai.
gitlab.en: Access GitLab projects and data through the registered adapter; requires authentication and appropriate project permissions.

mcp:gitlab.id: Akses proyek, issue, dan data GitLab melalui konektor MCP yang terdaftar; autentikasi dan izin proyek diperiksa terpisah, registrasi bukan bukti operasi berhasil.
mcp:gitlab.en: Access GitLab projects, issues, and data through the registered MCP connector; authentication and project permissions are checked separately, and registration does not prove successful operations.

mcp:tinyfish.id: Gunakan layanan otomasi/pencarian web Tinyfish melalui MCP untuk tugas yang diizinkan; perlu login serta izin kuota/biaya, registrasi bukan bukti koneksi berhasil.
mcp:tinyfish.en: Use Tinyfish web automation/search through MCP for authorized tasks; sign-in and quota/cost permission are required, and registration does not prove a working connection.

node.id: Jalankan tool/proyek JavaScript dengan Node.js lokal; memilih rute tidak memasang paket atau menjalankan proyek.
node.en: Run JavaScript tools/projects with local Node.js; selecting the route does not install packages or execute a project.

python.id: Jalankan tool/proyek Python lokal; memilih rute tidak memasang dependency atau menjalankan kode.
python.en: Run local Python tools/projects; selecting the route does not install dependencies or execute code.

graphify.id: Petakan hubungan file/kode menjadi graf proyek melalui Graphify lokal; perlu runtime serta input proyek yang dipilih.
graphify.en: Map file/code relationships into a project graph through local Graphify; requires its runtime and selected project input.

whatsapp-web.id: Akses WhatsApp Web saat tugas memerlukannya; perlu sesi akun dan izin terikat tugas, pengiriman pesan memerlukan otorisasi.
whatsapp-web.en: Access WhatsApp Web when required by a task; requires an account session and task-scoped permission, with authorization for sending messages.

hersona.id: Kelola personalisasi/persona melalui Hersona CLI; memilih rute tidak mengubah persona atau konfigurasi model.
hersona.en: Manage personalization/personas through Hersona CLI; selecting the route does not change personas or model configuration.

llmtrim.id: Padatkan payload yang memenuhi syarat melalui llmtrim CLI; manfaat bergantung input dan tidak menjamin penghematan seluruh tagihan token.
llmtrim.en: Compact eligible payloads through llmtrim CLI; savings depend on the input and do not guarantee lower total token billing.

auto-reconnect.id: Daftarkan rute yang sudah terdeteksi/terkonfigurasi; tidak membuka aplikasi, melakukan login, atau membuktikan operasi layanan berhasil.
auto-reconnect.en: Register routes already detected/configured; this does not open apps, sign in, or prove successful service operations.

select.id: Pilih rute satu per satu untuk registri profil ini; hanya yang dipilih ditambahkan, aplikasi tetap dibuka saat ada tugas.
select.en: Choose routes individually for this profile registry; only selected routes are added and apps remain task-triggered.

mcp.id: Konektor MCP yang terdaftar pada profil; fungsi rinci, autentikasi, runtime, izin, dan biaya layanan perlu diperiksa terpisah. Registrasi bukan bukti koneksi berhasil.
mcp.en: An MCP connector registered in this profile; verify its specific function, authentication, runtime, permissions, and service costs separately. Registration is not proof of a working connection.

cli_extension.id: Ekstensi CLI-Anything yang terdeteksi berdasarkan nama executable; fungsi belum diketahui dari deteksi ini. Periksa dokumentasi dan runtime sebelum menjalankannya.
cli_extension.en: A CLI-Anything extension detected by executable name; this detection does not establish its function. Review its documentation and runtime before running it.

unknown.id: Rute alat untuk tugas yang dipilih; periksa fungsi adapter, runtime, izin, dan biaya sebelum digunakan. Memilih rute tidak menjalankan alat.
unknown.en: A tool route for a selected task; check adapter function, runtime, permissions, and cost before use. Selecting a route does not execute the tool.

registration.id: Pilihan ini hanya mengatur registri rute. Aplikasi, runtime, login, izin akun, dan biaya layanan merupakan prasyarat terpisah; tidak ada aplikasi yang dibuka saat boot.
registration.en: These choices configure the route registry only. Apps, runtimes, sign-in, account permissions, and service costs are separate prerequisites; no app opens at boot.
